def main():
    s = input().strip()
    n = len(s)
    if n == 0:
        print(0)
        return
    sum_len = 1
    ans = 0
    for i in range(1, n):
        if s[i] == s[i-1]:
            sum_len += 1
        else:
            if sum_len % 2 == 0:
                ans += 1
            sum_len = 1
        if i == n-1:
            if sum_len % 2 == 0:
                ans += 1
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
